scope: The lead deferred Studio wording after the initial scope stop. No Studio, contract, dispatcher, runtime, Docker or demo changes.

decisions.queue: 16 waiting imports per case holds a small batch; 64 service-wide bounds four such batches. Running jobs do not spend queue slots. The existing 128 kept-imports per-case history bound stays.
decisions.running: DispatchReservations alone enforces DISPATCH_LANES.stream.concurrency (4, shared with streamed profiles). HTTP admission no longer duplicates a running limit.
decisions.doctor: One aggregate read-only line reports service queue, busiest-case queue and running imports; each warns at 75 percent. Reads stream concurrency from dispatch-lanes.ts without importing its TS dependency tree; queue numbers have parity assertions.
decisions.cancellation: Count only queued import receipts whose canonical jobs remain queued; cancellation frees capacity without deleting receipts. Existing canonical claim and source-pin checks remain authoritative.

acceptance: Full lane queues a new import; dispatcher reservation refuses its start, then admits it after release and the canonical claim makes it running.
16 queued in one case or 64 across cases refuses with exact plain words, 429 STREAMING_CAPACITY and {limit,freesAt:null}; starting one frees capacity.
Same request key returns the same job even at queue capacity.
Queued cancellation prevents a claim and frees capacity; supersession preserves historical freshness and refuses the claim.
Doctor separately tests all three 75-percent edges and its read-only aggregate query.
